<meta name="course.sales-pitch" content="<p style="text-align: justify;">The early years of life are a time of rapid brain development as the foundations of learning and development are laid. High quality early childhood education makes a difference to the lives of young children during their prior-to-school years and the early years of schooling. As an Early Childhood Education student you will focus on the education and care of children aged from birth to eight years, learning about educational psychology and sociology, early childhood curricula, and pedagogy.</p><p style="text-align: justify;">Overall you will experience 120 days of workplace learning in early childhood prior to school or school settings.</p><p style="text-align: justify;"><small><em>Note: The programme is not a Singapore Early Childhood Development Agency <br />(ECDA)-accredited programme. Graduates who wish to work in the local early childhood sector will need to submit an application to ECDA for Teacher Registration via a preschool. Approval by ECDA will be subjected to the applicant meeting the requirements for Teacher Registration.</em></small></p><!-- <p><a href="./?a&equals;11378" title="Download brochure" target="_blank">Download</a> our brochure to find out more about the Education degrees offered at JCU. Should you need further assistance, you can join the discussion below or contact us via <a href="tel:+6567093888" title="Call" target="_blank">phone</a> or our admissions <a href="mailto:admissions-singapore@jcu.edu.au?subject=Course%20Enquiry%20from%20Website">email</a>.</p> -->">

<meta name="course.subjects" content="<h3>Course Structure</h3><p><!--  3 trimesters per year <br style="padding: 0px;text-align: justify;text-indent: 0px" /><strong>Full-time:</strong> normally 4 subjects per trimester<br style="padding: 0px;text-align: justify;text-indent: 0px" /><strong>Part-time:</strong> normally 2 subjects per trimester--> 4 subjects in Trimester</p><h3>Subject Requirement</h3><p style="padding: 0px;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px">Students need to complete the following subjects:</p><table id="table01953" style="width: 100%; font-size:0.8em"><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #aaaaaa"><th style="padding-left:0.75em" id="table01953r1c1"><h3>Level 1</h3></th></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #aaaaaa"><td style="padding:0.75em" headers="table01953r1c1 table01953r3c1 table01953r5c1 table01953r7c1"><ul><li>Education Perspectives and Practice</li><li>Science and Sustainability in Education</li><li>Foundations of Language and Literacy in Education</li><li>Early Childhood Education and Care 1</li><li>Technologies for Early Childhood Education</li><li>Early Childhood Arts Education</li><li>Educational Psychology: Learners and Learning</li><li>Teaching Mathematics and Numeracy in Primary<br />and Early Childhood Settings</li></ul></td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #aaaaaa; padding-left:0.75em"><th style="padding-left:0.75em" id="table01953r3c1"><h3>Level 2</h3></th></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #aaaaaa"><td style="padding:0.75em" headers="table01953r1c1 table01953r3c1 table01953r5c1 table01953r7c1"><ul><li>Health and Physical Education for Early Childhood</li><li>Early Childhood Mathematics and Numeracy</li><li>Early Childhood Education Language and Literacy</li><li>Planning for Engaging Learning</li><li>Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Education</li><li>Humanities and Social Sciences for Early Childhood</li><li>Science Education for Early Childhood</li><li>Students with Reading Difficulties</li></ul></td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #aaaaaa; padding-left:0.75em"><th style="padding-left:0.75em" id="table01953r5c1"><h3>Level 3</h3></th></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #aaaaaa"><td style="padding:0.75em" headers="table01953r1c1 table01953r3c1 table01953r5c1 table01953r7c1"><ul><li>Inclusive Education: Differentiated Learning for Students with Special Needs and Abilities</li><li>English as an Additional Language/Dialect for Indigenous Learners</li><li>Technologies Across the Curriculum</li><li>Advanced English Education for Early Childhood</li><li>Early Childhood Mathematics and Numeracy 2</li><li>Reflective Teaching Cycles and Positive Learning Environments (ECE)</li><li>Early Childhood Education and Care 2</li></ul></td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #aaaaaa; padding-left:0.75em"><th style="padding-left:0.75em" id="table01953r7c1"><h3>Level 4</h3></th></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #aaaaaa"><td style="padding:0.75em" headers="table01953r1c1 table01953r3c1 table01953r5c1 table01953r7c1"><ul><li>Service Learning for Sustainable Futures</li><li>Indigenous Futures</li><li>Fourth Year Professional Experience A (Australia) /&nbsp;Fourth Year Professional Experience A (Singapore)</li><li>Fourth Year Professional Experience B (Australia) / Fourth Year Professional Experience B (Singapore)</li><li>Leading Wellbeing and Sustainability in Learning Communities</li><li>Teachers as Ethical and Collaborative Change Agents</li><li>Education across Culturally Diverse Contexts</li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table><p style="text-align: justify;">In addition, students complete 120 days of professional placement across the degree in a range of settings for children 0-8 years of age in Singapore and other approved international sites as required.</p><h4>Additional Information</h4><p style="text-align: justify;">1. As a default, Bachelor of Early Childhood Education students will be enrolled into the Singapore versions of this subject: Fourth Year Professional Experience A (Singapore)</p><p>2. As a default, Bachelor of Early Childhood Education students will be enrolled into the Singapore versions of this subject: Fourth Year Professional Experience B (Singapore)</p><p>3. All students are required to attend a compulsory 5-day on-campus intensive Professional Orientation Program in their final year of study. This intensive program prepares students transition to teaching.</p><p>4. International students on a Student Pass will require a Training Work Permit to complete the teaching focussed professional experience in Singapore. Subject to the necessary approval, students may also be able to organise their own teaching focussed professional experience in their home country or countries other than Singapore.</p><hr /><div><div id="accordion__subjects" role="region" aria-expanded="true"><p>Total Credit Points: 96</p><p>For a comprehensive listing and&nbsp;outline of the respective course subjects and assessment details, please click&nbsp;<a target="_blank" href="https://handbook.jcu.edu.au/">here</a>.</p></div></div>">

<meta name="course.prerequisities" content="<h3>Entry Requirements</h3><ul style="text-align: justify;"><li>The entry requirement for the course is satisfactory completion of 12 years of schooling or equivalent including English, Maths and Science at year 12 level</li></ul><h3>English Requirements</h3><p>Applicants of non-English speaking backgrounds must meet</p><ul><li>the English language proficiency requirements of IELTS 6.5 <br />(no component lower than 6.0) / TOEFL (Internet Based) 86 (no component less than 21) / Pearson PTE Academic 58 (no component less than 54); or</li><li>Satisfactory completion of James Cook University Singapore English Language Preparatory Program (ELPP); or</li><li>Successful completion of other qualifications completed in English Language deemed comparable to Australian standards on a case-by-case basis in accordance to JCU admissions guidelines.</li></ul><h3>Attendance Requirements</h3><p style="text-align: justify;">International students holding a valid Student&rsquo;s Pass are required to attend at least 90% of scheduled classes per month. Failure to attend classes is a breach of the student visa conditions. Being absent from classes for a continuous period of seven days or more, or attendance falling below 90% without valid reasons will result in the student needing to surrender their Student's Pass for cancellation.</p><p style="text-align: justify;">Domestic students must attend at least 75% of the scheduled lecture and tutorial activities to be eligible for assessment.</p>">
<meta name="course.career-outcomes" content="<p style="text-align: justify;">Early Childhood Education is a specialized field of education that leads to leadership positions in kindergartens and preschools or teaching positions in international schools in Singapore, teaching positions in kindergartens, preschools and schools. Recognition of the qualification in other nations needs to be individually pursued.</p>">

                        <div class="coursedetails__intro"><p style="text-align: justify;">The early years of life are a time of rapid brain development as the foundations of learning and development are laid. High quality early childhood education makes a difference to the lives of young children during their prior-to-school years and the early years of schooling. As an Early Childhood Education student you will focus on the education and care of children aged from birth to eight years, learning about educational psychology and sociology, early childhood curricula, and pedagogy.</p><p style="text-align: justify;">Overall you will experience 120 days of workplace learning in early childhood prior to school or school settings.</p><p style="text-align: justify;"><small><em>Note: The programme is not a Singapore Early Childhood Development Agency <br>(ECDA)-accredited programme. <script>
//Show / Hide content section script
$(function () {
  // On load: collapse every expandable section whose trigger starts .collapsed
  $('.general-content-block').each(function () {
    var $block = $(this);
    var $link  = $block.find('.link-collapse').first();
    if ($link.hasClass('collapsed')) {
      $block.find('.expandable-content').hide();
    }
  });
 
  // Delegated click handler
  $(document).on('click', '.link-collapse', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var $link   = $(this);
    var $target = $link.closest('.general-content-block').find('.expandable-content').first();
 
    $target.stop(true, true).slideToggle(200);
 
    var willCollapse = !$link.hasClass('collapsed');   // state AFTER this click
    $link.toggleClass('collapsed')
         .attr('aria-expanded', !willCollapse);
  });
});
